info.title: SureMandarin App API
info.description: Official REST API contract for the SureMandarin website, iOS app, Android app, and mini program. Public content endpoints do not require a token. Member endpoints require Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.

bearerAuth.description: JWT returned by a successful login or registration. Send it as: Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.

post.description: Creates a registered member and returns a JWT. Mobile clients should set registrationPlatform to ios, android, or miniprogram.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

get.description: Browser redirect flow for Google, Facebook, or X. The provider callback ultimately returns through the configured SureMandarin frontend callback.
Exchanges the provider callback code for a SureMandarin JWT. Usually called by the website callback rather than directly by the app.
